name: LiDAR mapping
description: For four days in July 2003, an aircraft crossed Christchurch and part of the adjoining Waimakariri River corridor carrying a laser scanner. Christchurch City Council commissioned the survey, flown by AAM GeoScan from 6 to 9 July.
